release_boundary.sequence: Continue current V0.1/V0.2 gates before V0.3 inventory/purchasing and V0.4 transactional POS. Planning coverage does not complete any release, requirement or physical acceptance gate.

current_contract.available_quantity_formula: SUM of signed admitted ledger quantities within organization/product/location scope; this is not a physical count.
current_contract.consumption_semantics: RESERVE subtracts availability. RELEASE restores it. CONSUME restores the hold and atomically appends a negative ADJUST physical issue. Preserve existing history and command idempotency; future named kinds require an explicit compatible contract/migration, not relabeling existing rows. Historical standalone CONSUME entries retain their original meaning; do not infer missing links or reconstruct balances from one history page.
current_contract.product_roles: A part consumed in workshop work and the same item sold by a shop are uses of a product. No requirement mandates duplicate catalogs or independent balances by channel. Shared identity across physical locations remains future design; current Product has one required location.
current_contract.service_boundary: Quote LaborLine arithmetic is not a nonstock product catalog, sale, payment or settlement. No mounted supplier/PO/POS/payment/cash workflow exists at the source revision.

dated_evidence.scope: Existing scoped connected-read PostgreSQL and native inventory journeys only; source files were compared to the tested revision. These results do not prove named business movements, physical stock, full offline inventory, POS/purchasing or V0.3 capacity. They do not qualify the new planning commit.

requirements.current: Product supports scoped UUID/SKU/name/unit and creation/list reads; SKU is unique per organization and each product belongs to one location.
missing: Shared product identity and per-location holdings usable by workshop and retail; search/scanning and complete inventory command UI.
acceptance: Define a single product/SKU identity usable as workshop part and retail merchandise without duplicating balances by channel; migrate existing location-bound products without losing identity/history.

Test variants, EAN/scanner lookup, categories and integer unit validation; reject ambiguity and cross-tenant lookup. Fractional units need explicit precision/conversion policy and versioned migration before support.

Provide accessible authorized catalog create/edit/archive controls; archiving preserves historical references and pending work. Show loading, failed, stale and unknown state explicitly, with no hidden write or destructive ledger editing.

requirements.current: Reads and commands scope products/balances to a required product location; the model does not expose one shared product at multiple stock locations.
missing: Shared product holdings across locations and authorized transfers.
Atomic transfer conservation, cancellation/compensation and location-specific read/write admission.
acceptance: The same product identity has separately scoped physical/reserved/available balances per location; a transfer applies paired effects exactly once and conserves organization total.
Failure or denied source/destination authority changes neither side; cross-location visibility follows current grants, not profile settings.

requirements.current: Public supported writes append ADJUST/RESERVE/RELEASE/CONSUME movements, with atomic consumption and duplicate-command protection.
missing: Named PURCHASE/SALE/WORKSHOP_USE/RETURN/ADJUSTMENT/TRANSFER/LOSS/DAMAGE/DONATION/REUSE business contracts and entry points.
Offline inventory command policy and all-channel transactional effects.
acceptance: Every admitted business stock change creates immutable referenced movements with audit context; retries and failures do not create additional effects.

Keep current CONSUME plus companion ADJUST semantics intact; define compatible future named-kind/version migrations rather than rewriting ledger history. R03 defines the inventory SALE contract; actual POS sale orchestration and sale/reservation competition qualify in R04.

requirements.current: Available quantity is derived from SUM of signed ledger entries, including reservation/finalization effects; a physical/reserved breakdown is not returned.
missing: Verifiable materialized projection and reconciliation report.
Separate physical quantity, reservation holds and sellable availability; multi-device offline and capacity qualification.
acceptance: Projection rebuild and incremental application agree with the immutable ledger for each product/location, including holds, finalization and compensation.
Qualify concurrent last-unit intents, reconnect and 100k+ movement budgets against exact source/fixtures; connected-read performance evidence alone does not close full inventory capacity.

requirements.current: No stock-minimum field, threshold alert or replenishment workflow exists in the current product/read model.
missing: Per-product/location threshold policy, authorized low-stock views and alert lifecycle.
acceptance: Evaluate documented threshold boundaries against defined available/physical quantity, units and location; disabled/zero thresholds and replenishment transitions have deterministic tests.
Show accessible scoped alerts without widening product visibility or issuing external notifications without an explicit integration contract.

requirements.current: Product catalog has no cost/price/margin fields. Quote line arithmetic does not establish product valuation or financial settlement.
missing: Cost history/valuation policy, currency-aware pricing and margin with defined discounts/taxes/returns.
acceptance: Preserve cost/provider snapshots at receipt and price/currency snapshots at sale; define rounding and valuation before deriving margin.
Unknown cost stays distinct from zero/free cost; partial returns, discounts and taxes reconcile with source movements and payment records without floating-point monetary drift.

requirements.current: No mounted supplier domain or workflow exists; a ledger reference is not supplier management.
missing: Scoped supplier records, operational lifecycle, references and authorization.
acceptance: Create/read/update authorized suppliers, preserve receipt/PO historical references and deny cross-tenant lookup; archived suppliers retain history.

requirements.current: No PurchaseOrder or receiving workflow is mounted. ADJUST is a stock primitive, not purchase receipt processing.
missing: PO state transitions, partial/full receiving, supplier/cost snapshots, duplicate/concurrent receipt policy and compensation.
acceptance: Ordered 10, received 4 then 6 produces received 10 and physical +10 exactly once; duplicate or concurrent receipt cannot over-receive silently or duplicate stock.
A failed receipt commits neither order progress nor ledger/cost effects; cancellation/returns follow explicit referenced compensation and preserve history.
Provide authorized PO creation/status and partial/full receiving actions with accessible pending/error/unknown states; a read-only inventory page does not satisfy this workflow.

requirements.current: Signed ADJUST can correct quantity, but named return/damage/loss/donation/reuse workflows and policy are absent.
missing: Explicit business reasons, approval/audit policy, return lineage and compensating workflows.
acceptance: Each named event records its source/reason, location, disposition and allowed stock effect; duplicate events cannot add/remove stock twice.

Retail returns reference the original sale and permitted quantity/disposition; refund and restock policy reconcile with payment and inventory ledgers rather than treating every return as reusable stock.

requirements.current: Signed adjustments and append-only history exist; there is no physical count session or count/reconciliation user journey.
missing: Count capture, discrepancy review, authorized compensating adjustment and concurrency/cutoff policy.
acceptance: An observed physical count records its time/scope and compares against a defined physical ledger baseline, not reservation-reduced availability.

Expected physical 10/reserved 2, count 9 creates a -1 physical compensation, leaving physical 9/reserved 2/available 7; never rewrite earlier movements or treat a synthetic fixture as real stock verification.
Provide explicit authorized count/review/adjustment controls with stale/unknown handling, actor/reason and recoverable errors; never expose arbitrary edit/delete of ledger history.

requirements.current: All current products use the stock ledger; no explicit stock-managed/nonstock/service catalog policy exists. LaborLine is quote arithmetic only.
missing: Explicit stock policy and nonstock/service catalog entries available to supported workshop/retail profiles.
acceptance: Sell/bill an admitted nonstock item or service without creating reserve/consume/sale stock effects; unavailable stock is not represented as zero available units for a nonstock service.
Mixed stocked/nonstock carts and order settlement reconcile monetary totals while only eligible stock-managed lines affect inventory; no bicycle/order is required for independent retail service sale.

requirements.current: No structured extensible compatibility attributes/rules exist in the current basic product model.
missing: Versioned extensible product compatibility metadata and later structured compatibility assistance.
acceptance: Define safe versioned catalog metadata/extension boundaries in R03-T001 without coupling them to executable plugins or claiming a compatibility recommendation.
Qualify structured rules/unknown/incompatible outcomes under existing R07-T004 in V0.7; preserve provenance, authorization and historical product references.

Shared Product/SKU identity, category/brand/variants/EAN/unit and explicit stocked/nonstock/service policy preserve existing IDs/history; basic compatibility metadata remains extensible without claiming the V0.7 assistant.
Operator create/edit/archive controls preserve source references and pending work; listing alone does not qualify catalog management.
Append-only scoped ledger admits no destructive rewrite; each referenced command/effect has explicit idempotency and atomic failure behavior.
All named movement kinds have defined physical/reservation/availability effects and compensations; preserve legacy CONSUME semantics. SALE here is an inventory contract, not an implemented POS sale.
Incremental materialized stock equals ledger rebuild, separately defining physical quantity, holds and availability across all admitted movement kinds.
One product identity supports scoped holdings; paired transfers conserve total stock and require authority on both locations, with rollback on any failure.
Low-stock thresholds are location/unit-aware with deterministic boundaries and scoped accessible replenishment alerts.
Supplier lifecycle preserves purchase history and permits only authorized scoped lookup/change.
PurchaseOrder transitions preserve ordered/received/cancelled balances and reject invalid or duplicate transitions.
Accessible authorized PO creation/status UI makes prerequisites and pending/error/unknown states explicit.
Partial/full receipt atomically updates PO progress, cost snapshots and inventory exactly once; failure, duplicate and concurrent receipt are explicit.
Authorized operator receiving UI supports explicit partial/full receipt and safe duplicate/failure recovery, not a generic adjustment substitute.
Cost and supplier histories retain source receipts/currency; valuation and unknown-cost policy precede margin reporting.
Reserve/release/consume a part for an authorized ServiceOrder atomically; completed consumption has one physical effect and traceable lineage for future POS billing.
Contextual workshop UI exposes authorized reserve/release/consume and current stock/hold state; stale/unknown state cannot silently authorize a stock write.
Physical count discrepancies and business adjustments create authorized, reasoned compensating movements, preserving history and reservation semantics.
Explicit authorized physical-count review and adjustment actions record reason/actor and recoverable pending/error states; never provide destructive ledger editing.
Authorized search and QR/EAN/barcode scan resolve the correct variant/SKU; ambiguous/unknown input and keyboard fallback are accessible.
Dense inventory workflows expose catalog, balances, thresholds, receipts/costs and count adjustments with keyboard/a11y coverage, explicit pending/errors and no authority from navigation.

Operator UI includes create/edit/archive catalog and explicit authorized transfer/count/adjust actions with keyboard navigation, stale/unknown/pending/error states and preserved history; dense read views alone are insufficient.
Multiple devices preserve idempotent receipt/workshop/adjustment intents and explicit conflict/recovery policy on reconnect; no unsupported offline stock guarantee.
Reconciliation explains projection/ledger and physical/held/available differences by location and source event, including receipts, consumption and compensation.
Exact-source reproducible 100k+ movement fixtures meet reviewed budgets for full admitted scope; retain raw evidence and do not infer physical stock from synthetic load.
Independent retail and service sale can select admitted products/services without a bicycle/order; workshop POS remains optional.
Currency-aware tax/discount/price rounding and audit policy are deterministic, including unknown costs and nonstock/service lines.
Sale aggregate snapshots lines/source order/product identities and supports explicit state/idempotency without inventing payment completion.
Payment records have stable idempotency keys, audit trail and failure recovery; retries never double-account settlement.
Partial and mixed-method payments preserve exact outstanding balance, with currency/provider state explicit.
Return/refund references original sale/payment and permitted quantity/disposition; compensation cannot duplicate refunds or restock inappropriate items.
Retail sale atomically deducts stocked lines using the same product/location ledger as workshop reservations; race for last unit produces one admitted physical claim, not negative silent stock.
POS collecting an order links its existing consumed parts and does not deduct them again; retries preserve the same monetary and stock effects.
Cash sessions reconcile admitted local payments, returns and adjustments without fabricating external provider confirmation.
Accessible printable receipts retain sale/payment/source references and locale/branding; a generic ticket is not a certified fiscal invoice.
Offline cash/local POS state has declared conflict/reconciliation policy coordinated with inventory; provider-dependent actions remain explicitly unavailable.
A disconnected user is never promised externally confirmed payment; clear recovery avoids silent automatic replay.
Sensitive discounts, returns and adjustments have scoped actor/reason/audit evidence without exposing protected cross-module data.
Property/integration/profile journeys reconcile Sale+Payment+Inventory, including last-unit competition, partial receipts, returns, duplicate commands and previously consumed order billing.
Complete intake/order/part reserve-consume workflow with POS disabled; preserve authorized offline/recovery behavior without implying full profile qualification from current read UI.
Profile changes only reviewed navigation/defaults; qualify accessibility, privacy, export, offline policy and recovery for this profile without issuing authority or losing data.
Receive and sell stocked/nonstock products independently without creating a bicycle or service order; qualify payment/return and explicit offline limits.
Profile changes only reviewed navigation/defaults; qualify accessibility, privacy, export, offline policy and recovery for this profile without issuing authority or losing data.
One SKU participates in purchasing, retail sale and workshop consumption; location balances reconcile and later payment of an already consumed order does not deduct stock again.
Profile changes only reviewed navigation/defaults; qualify accessibility, privacy, export, offline policy and recovery for this profile without issuing authority or losing data.

Operate the admitted service/cooperative navigation with inventory/POS/workshop modules optional; disabled/unavailable features preserve history and pending data. Qualify a dedicated supported journey before claiming this profile.
Profile changes only reviewed navigation/defaults; qualify accessibility, privacy, export, offline policy and recovery for this profile without issuing authority or losing data.

scenarios.notes: Physical and reserved numbers are future business acceptance dimensions, not extra fields currently returned by StockResponse; returned retail unit assumes an explicitly accepted reusable disposition.
A and B are authorized synthetic locations of one organization; transfer of reserved units is not granted by this scenario. Both effects commit or neither does.
Count observes physical stock, not availability; production concurrent movement/cutoff policy must be specified and qualified before this journey ships.
Bill a deliberately nonstock/service catalog line. N/A availability is not zero stock; normal financial/audit rules still apply.

This trace selects workshop admission first. The opposite ordering must also be tested: retail physical -1 first, then reservation denied. Offline intents remain provisional until the declared conflict policy resolves them.
